Hawaii Packing List

Based on Emma Johnson's Hawaii Vacation Itinerary (June 10-20, 2024)

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (for beach days, snorkeling, and kayaking)
- Sunscreen (essential for all outdoor activities)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike)
- Casual outfits (for shopping, dining, and general activities)
- Camera (to capture memories at all locations)
- Travel documents (passport, tickets, reservations)

Activity-Specific Items:
- Beach towel (for Waikiki Beach)
- Snorkeling equipment (if not renting at Hanauma Bay)
- Comfortable hiking shoes (for Diamond Head)
- Light jacket (for air-conditioned spaces and evening activities)
- Waterproof bag (for kayaking at Kailua Beach)
- Shopping bags (for Ala Moana Center)
